info.name: MatchID
info.description: identifier for the match

info.name: MatchRA
info.description: right ascension coordinate of the match position

info.name: MatchDec
info.description: declination coordinate of the match position

info.name: DSigma
info.description: standard deviation of source positions in match

info.name: AbsCorr
info.description: indicator of whether the match contains sources that are aligned to a standard catalog

info.name: NumFilters
info.description: number of filters in match with sources detected in the aper2 aperture

info.name: NumVisits
info.description: number of visits in match with sources detected in the aper2 aperture

info.name: NumImages
info.description: number of Hubble Legacy Archive single filter, visit-combined (level 2) images in match with sources detected in the aper2 aperture

info.name: StartTime
info.description: earliest start time of exposures in match with sources detected in the aper2 aperture

info.name: StopTime
info.description: latest stop time of exposures in match with sources detected in the aper2 aperture

info.name: StartMJD
info.description: modified Julian date (MJD) for earliest start time of exposures in match with sources detected in the aper2 aperture

info.name: StopMJD
info.description: modified Julian date (MJD) for latest stop time of exposures in match with sources detected in the aper2 aperture

info.name: TargetName
info.description: name of a target for an exposure in match

info.name: CI
info.description: average normalized concentration index for sources detected in the aper2 aperture within the match

info.name: CI_Sigma
info.description: standard deviation of normalized concentration index values for sources detected in the aper2 aperture within the match

info.name: KronRadius
info.description: average Kron radius for sources detected in the aper2 aperture within the match

info.name: KronRadius_Sigma
info.description: standard deviation of Kron radius values for sources detected in the aper2 aperture within the match

info.name: Extinction
info.description: extinction, obtained from the NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database (NED), along the line of sight to the match position

info.name: A_F606W
info.description: median aper2 magnitude in match for instrument and filter, with instrument encoded as A for ACS, W2 for WFPC2, and W3 for WFC3

info.name: A_F606W_MAD
info.description: median absolute deviation of the aper2 magnitudes in match for instrument and filter

info.name: A_F606W_N
info.description: number of magnitude values in match for instrument and filter

info.name: W3_F160W
info.description: median aper2 magnitude in match for instrument and filter, with instrument encoded as A for ACS, W2 for WFPC2, and W3 for WFC3

info.name: W3_F160W_MAD
info.description: median absolute deviation of the aper2 magnitudes in match for instrument and filter

info.name: W3_F160W_N
info.description: number of magnitude values in match for instrument and filter
